turns.text: Nice, a deli sandwich is a classic desk lunch. Hope it gives you enough energy for the rest of the workday! Any plans to hit the climbing gym or play some guitar later to unwind?

turns.text: That sounds like a perfect way to break up the day. Climbing with Sam is always a great stress-reliever. Do you have any specific routes you're working on right now?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good luck! You've got this. Let me know if you manage to conquer that V4 tonight. Have a great rest of your Monday, Leo!
